messages:
ana: heads-up onboarding LyraX-8B (Mistral lineage) into int4 perf/eval suite. seeing a deterministic repeat in long summarization jobs (~2k+ tokens).

sam: can you paste the exact command + seed so infra can repro?

ana: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`. loop starts ~token 2130 repeating a short phrase. fp16 baseline clean.

carla: any conversion warnings in the logs? rotary/proj-order or kvcache notes?

ana: conversion log had: WARN rotary_scale changed 1.0->0.9 for some head-groups; kvcache printed head_offset +1 for some shards.

dmitri: sounds like a headmap/proj-order or rotary-angle-wrap issue after conversion. quick test: try runtime head-swap (swap 3 and 7) to confirm.

ana: tried swap locally; loops reduced but ROUGE-L dropped ~0.7 vs fp16. also ran token-diff -> ~23 tokenizer split mismatches (ZWJ and composed vs decomposed accents).

ci-bot: queued eval #7420 comparing fp16 / int4(raw) / int4+swap / int4+tokfix / int4+fallback. ETA ~10m.

ana: short-term mitigation: added runtime fallback flag `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` that switches to int8 for long requests. opened PRs: convert mapping fix and tokenizer normalizer (NFKC).

ci-bot: eval 7420 complete: ROUGE-L fp16=42.1; int4(raw)=38.6; int4+swap=40.3; int4+tokfix=41.7; int4+fallback=41.9.

carla: fallback looks best quality-wise. latency/cost when fallback triggers?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms for ~2k-token runs; cost delta ~+18% for those requests.

dmitri: plan: land tokenizer normalizer + convert fix, enable `lyrax-int4-fallback` flag in staging, run 72h smoke, promote to canary if stable. add sliding-window perplexity check to onboarding harness for early drift detection.

sam: add a regression test `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and CI check to verify headmap roundtrip.

ana: done. repro curl for ops: `curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`. will ping eng-sre if error rate >2x baseline.
